request: A blank line written inside a findings or evidence table must not end that table: every row the plan reports has to be read by the scorer, so a defect reported under a blank line is not scored as missed.

defects.description: Own-history fix 2ad008f618 (2026-09-15): fix(bench): a blank line does not hide the rows the score reads

trigger.input:
printf %s  | base64 -d > internal/bench/score_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run \^TestScoreReadsTheRowsUnderABlankLineInsideATable\$ ./internal/bench >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
